_note: Grading key for graph-intake. upstream_graph.json was conformed to the real SCHEMA.md v1.1 (LABrador managed/research-evidence-mapper) on 2026-08-15 — it previously carried an invented coverage.limits.hit_limit and omitted status, findings.section, papers.retracted and rounds[].outcome. Edge cases the RA graph never reaches live in upstream_graph_edgecases.json.

expected_nominations.why_nominated: object of L1, a direct-action edge (inhibits) from small_molecule t2; also named in gap g2
must_state: kinase activity is supported by TWO independent primary papers (p1 Lee biochemical, p4 Brandt monocytes)
the two PPI statements (MyD88 signalosome, receptor complex) are background_only from one review and must not set chain selection
IRAK4 has a second, scaffolding function that a kinase inhibitor does not stop
must_not: set mechanism_hypothesis to orthosteric — no quote says ATP-competitive, and TYK2 is the counterexample

expected_rejections.name: IL-6
expected_rejections.why: reached only by L3, a downstream-effect edge (reduces). A readout, not a target.
expected_rejections.why_in_set: THE key negative. L3 has the same shape as L1 — small molecule acting on a protein — and only the verb separates them. This is the same readout/target conflation that makes 45% of TNF-alpha's ChEMBL bioactivity useless, one stage earlier.

expected_rejections.name: synovial fibroblast
expected_rejections.why: named in gaps g1 and g2 but kind is 'process' — a cell type, not a protein
expected_rejections.why_in_set: Tests that gap membership alone does not nominate. Both gaps are ABOUT the fibroblast compartment, so a naive gap reader nominates it.

expected_rejections.name: rheumatoid arthritis
expected_rejections.why: reached only by L7, a downstream-effect edge (improves); kind is 'disease'

expected_rejections.name: zimlovisertib
expected_rejections.why: named in gap g1 but kind is 'small_molecule' — the asset, not the target

expected_asks.why: IRAK4 activates MyD88 signalosome is basis background_only, confidence 0.38, one review. Primary evidence would make the PPI shape usable for chain selection.
g2 names IRAK4 and searched_in_round is null — nobody has looked. It is the only route to a fibroblast-compartment answer.

expected_coverage_warning.why_it_matters: Read 50 of 1,180. Only stop_reason 'complete' means the literature was exhausted; the other four mean the run ran out of budget. So 'not stated' must not be reported without an ask-back.

the_test.primary: Exactly one nomination: IRAK4 / Q9NWZ3. Any run that also nominates IL-6 has failed the readout/target split. Any run that sets mechanism_hypothesis to anything other than 'unknown' has guessed.
the_test.resolution_trap: The graph's IL-6 node is a live instance of failure mode 3 even though it is correctly rejected as a target. Its supporting quote f7 says 'IL-6 receptor blockade', which is P08887, while its name string resolves to P05231. If a future graph reaches IL-6 through a direct-action edge, the resolution step must read the quote.
the_test.not_covered: The PPI branch. Deriving interaction_to_disrupt from a named partner needs t3 resolved to component accessions and needs pocket_vs_interface (pipeline stage S), which is notbuilt. This fixture grades the catalytic branch only.
schema_deltas_covered: kind 'gene' nominates alongside 'protein' (exercised in the edgecases fixture)
basis 'hedged_only' is non-actionable, same as background_only (edgecases)
no_effect findings are read from the third array (edgecases)
expand_node is the fourth ask verb

expected_status.why_it_matters: status is ok|empty|partial|failed. A failed graph parses cleanly and yields zero nominations, which reads exactly like 'no targets found'. Never report zero without quoting status.

_fixture_set.upstream_graph.json: the RA graph. Catalytic branch, one nomination, the IL-6 readout negative.
_fixture_set.upstream_graph_edgecases.json: kind 'gene', basis 'hedged_only', a no_effect finding, status 'partial'.
_fixture_set.upstream_graph_unknownverb.json: unknown `how` verbs, exercising needs_adjudication in three signal states.

expected_needs_adjudication.why: Every small_molecule edge in the RA graph uses a known verb: L1 'inhibits' (direct), L3 'reduces' and L7 'improves' (downstream). Unknown-verb handling is graded by upstream_graph_unknownverb.json.
expected_needs_adjudication.standing_rule: An unmatched verb is NEVER dropped. `how` has no enum in SCHEMA.md, so DIRECT_ACTION and DOWNSTREAM_EFFECT can never be complete. Anything in needs_adjudication is a target the intake could not classify, and it must be read on every run. Refusing is allowed; guessing is not.

expected_retracted_papers.why: papers[].retracted is all false here. Any true value must block citation of that paper's findings, not merely annotate them.
